reason: The cut needs to happen before platelets can gather at the break, so I’ll start there.
expectation: I expect the rough edge to cause a small cut in the skin and blood vessel.

alternatives.reason: Making reinforcing threads also fits a goal, but I’d rather establish the break first.

effect: The cut exposes a leaking vessel, so I’ll work on the platelet plug first.
reaction: The narrowed vessel still leaking makes the need for a plug clear.
reason: The platelets are already shown gathering at the torn vessel, matching the plug goal.
expectation: I expect the platelets to gather into a plug that helps stop the leak.

alternatives.reason: The enzymes can help make reinforcing threads, but I want to make the plug first.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak, so the remaining goal is to reinforce it.
reaction: It makes sense that the plug slows blood loss before reinforcement.
reason: This is the only available combination, and the enzyme label says it helps clotting proteins form threads.
expectation: I expect the dissolved protein to form threads that can reinforce the plug.

effect: The proteins formed a mesh, and the new goal is to stop the bleeding.
reaction: The branching mesh makes its reinforcing role easy to picture.
reason: This is the only available combination, and adding the threads should reinforce the platelet plug.
expectation: I expect the mesh to strengthen the plug and stop the bleeding.

effect: The reinforced plug stopped the bleeding, but the skin remains open and still needs to heal.
reaction: The distinction between sealing the vessel and healing the skin was interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the protein mesh to the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how the two parts work together to stop bleeding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the threads was a little predictable: the enzyme label explained the pairing, and it was the only combination offered.

surprise.text: The vessel was sealed, but the skin above it was still open; stopping bleeding is only the first repair.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The cut, platelet plug and reinforcing mesh all had clear purposes.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the open skin heals, since stopping the bleeding left that question unanswered.
